title: Trace one publish through exchange bindings
description: Choose an exchange contract and an event. The routing map shows exactly which queues receive a copy and when a publish becomes unroutable.

exchanges.label: Direct exchange
exchanges.detail: A queue receives the message only when its binding key exactly equals the routing key.

exchanges.label: Topic exchange
exchanges.detail: Bindings use dot-separated words, where * matches one word and # matches zero or more words.

exchanges.label: Fanout exchange
exchanges.detail: Every bound queue receives a copy; the routing key is ignored.

queues.label: Fulfillment
queues.responsibility: Reserve stock and begin the shipment workflow.

queues.label: EU alerts
queues.responsibility: Notify operators about events in the European region.

queues.label: Analytics
queues.responsibility: Build an asynchronous record of all business events.
